CustomField.description: Set automatically by FundFieldApplicabilityHistoryTrigger (FundFieldApplicabilityHistoryHandler): record Id + ':' + lowercase FieldAPIName__c while the line is an open period (Applicability__c true, End_Date__c empty), empty otherwise. Unique, so the database rejects a second open period for the same record and field (DUPLICATE_VALUE), including from simultaneous transactions.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Technical key that allows a single open period per record and field. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Open Period Key
